headline: Approved first phase of Revo Casino redevelopment at 1279 South Willow Street; later phases continued to October.
summary: Phase I covers a consolidated lot, about 218 parking spaces, and water main work along John E. Devine Drive. Phases II and III were continued to the first meeting in October. Also approved were site plans for 159 Union Street and 434 Hevey Street, a lot line adjustment at 975 Cedar Street, and an amendment at 25 Lowell Street, while an amendment for 192 Mammoth Road was denied.
decisions: Continued the public hearing for Phases II and III of the casino redevelopment at 1279 South Willow Street to the first meeting in October.

Continued the public hearing for PDSP2024-002 at Orange Street & Pearl Street to September 3, 2026.

Approved conditional use permit to reduce parking for Phase I of the casino project at 1279 South Willow Street. Motion carried.

Approved site plan for Phase I of the casino redevelopment at 1279 South Willow Street. Motion carried.
Continued the S2026-011, SP2026-011, and CU2026-005 items for 1265 South Willow Street, which are not part of Phase I.
Approved SP2022-011 compliance hearing for the 98-unit apartment building at 351 Chestnut Street. Motion carried.
Denied the amendment to conditions of approval for 192 Mammoth Road. Motion to deny carried.
Approved lot line adjustment at 975 Cedar St, Auburn Street and 1040 Auburn Street. Motion carried.
Approved waivers from landscaping, illumination, and refuse container requirements for 159 Union Street. Motion carried.
Approved site plan to add four new units to the existing building at 159 Union Street. Motion carried.
Approved amendment to the site plan for the 25 Lowell Street parking lot, including a required landscaped area. Motion carried.
Determined that applications S2026-016, IMP2026-001, and S2024-011 – Extension do not have regional impact and do not warrant Conservation Commission review. Motion carried.
Approved the July 16, 2026 meeting minutes as written, with one abstention. Motion carried.
